title: "Hedy: A Gradual programming language" by Felienne Hermans (Strange Loop 2022)
summary: Felienne Hermans presents Hedy, a gradual programming language for teaching kids that moves through levels from almost no syntax toward full Python. The talk covers why error messages and syntax are scary for beginners.
why: HN points to it in beginner-programming-education threads for its distinction between easy to learn and easy to teach.

quote.text: One of the themes they talk about is the difference between "easy to learn" and "easy to teach" which I found insightful.
